title: Embedding Search P0: Foundation
description:
Implement Phase 0 of embedding-based semantic search for beads.

Design doc: kbeads/docs/design-embedding-search.md (branch sketch/embedding-search)

Scope: pgvector migration, Embedder interface, Ollama backend, store methods, HTTP search endpoint, CLI integration (kd search --semantic, kd embed sync).

All work happens in the gardenio repo on a feature branch off main.

steps.title: Add pgvector migration (005_bead_embeddings)
steps.description:
Create migration files `005_bead_embeddings.up.sql` and `005_bead_embeddings.down.sql` in `kbeads/internal/store/postgres/migrations/`.

Up migration:
- CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector
- CREATE TABLE bead_embeddings (bead_id TEXT PK FK→beads, embedding vector(1024), model TEXT NOT NULL, text_hash TEXT NOT NULL, fleet TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default', created_at TIMESTAMPTZ, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ)
- CREATE INDEX idx_bead_embeddings_ivfflat ON bead_embeddings USING ivfflat (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (lists = 100)
- CREATE INDEX idx_bead_embeddings_fleet ON bead_embeddings(fleet)

Down migration:
- DROP TABLE IF EXISTS bead_embeddings (do NOT drop the vector extension)

See design doc section 1 for exact SQL.

steps.title: Create Embedder interface and text helpers
steps.description:
Create package `kbeads/internal/embedding/` with:

1. `embedder.go` — Embedder interface: Embed(ctx, text) ([]float32, error), EmbedBatch(ctx, []string) ([][]float32, error), ModelName() string, Dimensions() int

2. `text.go` — BeadText(bead) string (concatenates Title, Type, Description, Notes, Labels with field prefixes), TextHash(text) string (SHA-256 hex)

3. `noop.go` — NoopEmbedder that returns errors (for disabled mode)

See design doc sections 3 and 4 for exact signatures and text construction format.

steps.title: Implement Ollama embedding backend
steps.description:
Create `kbeads/internal/embedding/ollama.go`:

- OllamaEmbedder struct with baseURL, model, dims, http.Client
- NewOllamaEmbedder(baseURL, model string) constructor (default dims=1024 for nomic-embed-text)
- Embed() calls POST {baseURL}/api/embed with {model, input: text}
- EmbedBatch() calls same endpoint with {model, input: []texts} (Ollama supports batch natively)
- ModelName() returns model string, Dimensions() returns dims

See design doc section 3 for the full implementation sketch.

Write unit tests that mock the HTTP calls.

steps.title: Add embedding store methods to Store interface and Postgres implementation
steps.description:
Extend `kbeads/internal/store/store.go` with 4 new methods:
- UpsertEmbedding(ctx, beadID string, embedding []float32, model string, textHash string) error
- SemanticSearch(ctx, queryVec []float32, filter BeadFilter, limit int) ([]*SemanticResult, error)
- DeleteEmbedding(ctx, beadID string) error
- GetEmbeddingStats(ctx) (*EmbeddingStats, error)

Add model types in `kbeads/internal/model/embedding.go`:
- SemanticResult{Bead, Score float64, Distance float64}
- EmbeddingStats{TotalBeads, EmbeddedBeads int, Model string, StaleCount int}

Implement in `kbeads/internal/store/postgres/queries_embedding.go`:
- UpsertEmbedding: INSERT ON CONFLICT UPDATE
- SemanticSearch: SELECT b.*, 1-(e.embedding <=> $1::vector) AS score FROM bead_embeddings e JOIN beads b ON b.id=e.bead_id WHERE [filters] ORDER BY e.embedding <=> $1::vector LIMIT $N
- DeleteEmbedding: DELETE FROM bead_embeddings WHERE bead_id=$1
- GetEmbeddingStats: COUNT queries comparing beads vs bead_embeddings

See design doc sections 5 and 6 for exact SQL and types.

Update sqlmock tests.

steps.title: Add POST /v1/search/semantic HTTP endpoint
steps.description:
Create `kbeads/internal/server/http_search.go` with handleSemanticSearch handler.

Request body: {query string, status []string, type []string, kind []string, labels []string, assignee string, fleet string, limit int, min_score float64}

Handler flow:
1. Decode JSON body, validate query is non-empty, default limit=20
2. Embed query text via s.embedder.Embed(ctx, query)
3. Build BeadFilter from request fields + fleet from context
4. Call s.store.SemanticSearch(ctx, queryVec, filter, limit)
5. Filter by min_score if set
6. writeJSON response

Register route in http.go: mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/search/semantic", requireRole(RoleViewer, s.handleSemanticSearch))

Add embedder field to BeadsServer struct. Wire it up in server initialization (read BEADS_EMBED_BACKEND env var to pick provider).

See design doc section 8 for handler sketch.

steps.title: Add SemanticSearch gRPC RPC
steps.description:
Extend proto definitions:
- Add SemanticSearchRequest, SemanticSearchResult, SemanticSearchResponse messages to beads.proto
- Add SemanticSearch RPC to BeadsService in service.proto
- Run make proto to regenerate
- Implement the gRPC handler in internal/server/grpc.go mirroring the HTTP handler logic

See design doc section 7 for proto definitions.

steps.title: Add --semantic flag to kd search
steps.description:
Modify `kbeads/cmd/kd/search.go` to add a --semantic boolean flag.

When --semantic is set:
- Call POST /v1/search/semantic instead of GET /v1/beads
- Pass query text + any filters (--status, --type, --where, etc.)
- Display results with similarity scores

Add the HTTP client method in internal/client/http.go: SemanticSearch(ctx, query, filters, limit) ([]*SemanticResult, error)

steps.title: Add kd embed sync command for backfill
steps.description:
Create `kbeads/cmd/kd/embed.go` with an embed command group:

`kd embed sync [--fleet default] [--batch-size 50] [--force]`

Flow:
1. Paginate through all beads via GET /v1/beads (batch-size per page)
2. For each bead, compute BeadText() and TextHash()
3. Skip if not --force and hash matches existing embedding
4. Call embedder.EmbedBatch() on the batch texts
5. Upsert embeddings via a new POST /v1/embeddings/sync endpoint (or direct store call if running server-side)

This needs a server-side endpoint: POST /v1/embeddings/upsert (admin-only) that accepts {bead_id, embedding, model, text_hash}.

Progress output: print batch progress (e.g., 'Embedded 50/1700 beads...').

steps.title: Add embedding configuration env vars and server wiring
steps.description:
Extend `kbeads/internal/config/config.go` with new fields:
- EmbedBackend string (env: BEADS_EMBED_BACKEND, default: 'noop')
- EmbedURL string (env: BEADS_EMBED_URL, default: 'http://localhost:11434')
- EmbedAPIKey string (env: BEADS_EMBED_API_KEY)
- EmbedModel string (env: BEADS_EMBED_MODEL)

Add a factory function NewEmbedder(cfg) Embedder that returns the right backend based on EmbedBackend.

Wire into server.go: create embedder during server init, pass to BeadsServer.

steps.title: Add tests for embedding pipeline
steps.description:
Write tests covering:
1. embedding/text_test.go — BeadText() produces correct concatenation, TextHash() is stable
2. embedding/ollama_test.go — OllamaEmbedder with httptest mock server
3. store/postgres tests — SemanticSearch query building (sqlmock)
4. server/http_search_test.go — handleSemanticSearch handler (httptest + mock store + mock embedder)

Tests must exercise the actual code paths. Do NOT write superficial mocks.

steps.title: Push branch and open MR
steps.description:
Push all work to a feature branch (feat/embedding-search-p0) and open a merge request targeting main.

MR description should reference:
- Design doc: kbeads/docs/design-embedding-search.md
- Bead: ka-0000003874
- Phase: P0 foundation
- What's included and what's deferred to P1+

Run `make build` and `go test ./...` before pushing. Fix any issues.
